_doc: Monster behaviour, first wave (AI-1, 2026-11-19): the numbers and lines of each behaviour, one section each. The per-kind fields (light_shy, alarm, death_throes, relurks, hides_in_dark, drain_share, drain_con, morale, morale_style, heal_cooldown, heal_below, summon_live_cap; on an attack recharge, drains_life, snuffs_light, snuff_chance, shove) are in data/monsters.json and read through src/kind_data.py. Lines are filled by monster.fill: {The} {the} {A} {a} and the pronoun slots {he} {He} {him} {his} {His} {himself}. A line with 'unseen' in its key is said when the hero cannot see the creature: it never names it. docs/systems/monsters.md, 'Monster behaviour, first wave', says what each one does. The third wave (AI-3, 2026-11-20): casters, holds, auras, home_ground, kit, skittish and surprise; the per-kind fields spells, aura, territorial, lair_radius, lair_line, kit, bargain and, on an attack, hold ('Monster behaviour, third wave').

healer._doc: src/faction.py: a healer mends only its own side (war-band, else pack, else family, else kind), only a friend under heal_below of its health, the one fighting the hero first, then the most hurt; then it rests its voice heal_cooldown turns.

summoner._doc: src/summoning.py: the timer runs only while it hunts the hero; it calls only with the hero within reach and in sight and fewer than live_cap of its summoned standing; the call is a one-turn chant that a landed blow breaks. A chant is broken by any real blow (never a bleed, burn or poison ticking); spoil_lines name who broke it: the hero, his pet ({pet}), a death throes' blast, or something else (a hazard, another creature). 'held' is for a chant broken by no blow: sleep, a hold, a stun, fright, charm, silence, its nerve gone.
summoner.chant_line: {The} raises {his} hands and begins to chant.
summoner.chant_unseen: Somewhere near, a voice begins a low chant.

spoil_lines.other: {The} is struck, and {his} chant breaks off.

breath._doc: src/breath.py: a delivery 'breath' attack of an ordinary kind needs 3 turns before it can come again (an attack's own `recharge` wins); named foes only when their data says. ready_lines by the breath's damage type, said when it is ready again and the hero can see it.

ready_lines.acid: Something hisses and drips from {the}'s jaws.
ready_lines.poison: A green haze seeps from {the}'s jaws.
ready_lines.necrotic: A grave-cold mist gathers in {the}'s throat.

morale._doc: src/morale.py. A creature's style and nerve: its kind's own morale_style / morale in monsters.json, else its family's row, else default; a tag in never_tags, `fearless` or a status_immune 'feared' make it never. A check (2d10 over morale, less the trigger's penalty, breaks it) the first time it falls under break_share of its health, when one of its side falls within kin_sight while it is under courage_share, and after futile_blows landed blows in a row that did nothing. Healed above courage_share it steadies. A flight lasts flee_turns (a bolt bolt_turns); regroup runs to its side within rally_reach and rouses those within rally_rouse of the one it reached; a withdrawing creature strikes a hero who presses it withdraw_strikes of the time (a fighting withdrawal); cornered beside the hero it is at bay at_bay_turns turns, at_bay_hit better to hit. A bolted creature has given up the fight (cowed): it keeps away from a hero it can see. Every ordinary hunter keeps a nerve (morale.RULED_PATTERNS: aggressive, cowardly, ranged, hit_and_run, summoner, healer, dragon, dancer); the rooted, a mimic or ambusher still in wait, the stalker and the named never break. One that has yielded never strikes again, held or not.

lines.rally: {The} brings {his} friends back into the fight!
lines.yield: {The} throws down {his} weapon and {his} purse and begs for {his} life!

unseen.regroup: Running feet, and a shout for help.

never_lines.restless_dead: {The} does not care that {he} is falling apart.
never_lines.constructs: {The} grinds on, cracked and shedding dust.
never_lines.elementals: {The} gutters but does not give way.
never_lines.ghosts: {The} wavers, but the dead do not run.

life_drain._doc: src/life_drain.py. A landed drain blow (type 'drain', or an attack with drains_life) whose CON save fails lowers the hero's max HP by drain_share of the blow (the kind's own drain_share wins), at most blow_cap of his whole health from one blow and total_cap in all, never below a new hero's health (Player.starting_max_hp). Half comes back at the next new floor down (stairs_line), all from the physician's Restore and the Mercy prayer at chain 4 (restore_line). drain_con kinds (the liches, the death lord) also cost a CON point once a floor, as before; named foes keep only that old rule.
life_drain.stairs_line: Sleep gives back some of what the dead took. (Max HP +{n})
life_drain.restore_line: What the dead took from you comes back. (Max HP +{n})

grave_rot._doc: src/grave_rot.py. A disease a monster gives lasts its own effect_duration, times its kind's disease_linger (default_linger 1 unless its lore makes it linger), at most cap (never past status_effects.MAX_EFFECT_DURATION, 60). While the hero is diseased, rest does not mend him and every heal does half. On a monster it costs a share of its health a turn (poison's rate) and stops its regeneration.

light_shy._doc: src/light_shy.py. A light_shy creature within the reach of the hero's light (its sight) needs per_glare more to hit him for each point of glare, at most cap: a carried light `carried` (or its own in glare_by_light), the Light spell `spell`, a torch held as a weapon `weapon`. A regenerating one cannot close its wounds in the light; a turns_to_stone_in_light one in the Light spell's glare for stiffen_turns turns is slowed slowed_turns. snuffs_light on an attack douses the hero's held light (not an everlasting one or one with a power), soaked for wet_turns; 'dark' ends the Light spell too.

lines.unmended: {The}'s wounds stop closing in your light.
lines.stiffen: {The}'s hide stiffens in the light, like stone!
lines.soaked: The wick is soaked. It will not light yet.

gone_again._doc: src/gone_again.py. A hit-and-run creature that cannot walk through walls retreats to the nearest tile out of the hero's sight (a search of at most search_tiles tiles) and hides there; the hero coming within spot_reach or seeing it ends the hiding (it runs again if it has blows left, else it hunts); a blow ends it at once. A hides_in_dark one is unseen while it hides and the hero carries no lit light.

alarm._doc: src/alarm.py. A creature with `alarm` that first sees the hero shouts once a floor: every creature of its side (same kind, band, pack, family, or a tag in alarm.tags) the sound reaches within alarm.radius is roused to him; a sleeper wakes as to any loud noise (the Hand of Glory keeps sleepers asleep). It rouses only creatures already on the floor.

death_throes._doc: src/death_throes.py. A creature with `death_throes` that dies (not banished, not ashed) bursts: every creature and the hero within its radius (and in its sight) takes floor_curve.wound(share) of its own health in its type, and its effect with a save. Its warn_line is said once when it falls under warn_share of its health. A creature killed by another's throes bursts after it, never inside it (one at a time). An `alarm_radius` on a death throes is a cry that goes through stone (the mandrake's shriek): every creature that hears within it is roused to the hero (alarm.cry).

relurk._doc: src/relurk.py. A sprung ambusher with relurks, under hurt_share of its health, with no sight of the hero for lost_turns turns and not hunting him, goes back into hiding (an ambusher again, unaware) once a life; its next spring has no surprise blow.
relurk.line_unseen: Something scuttles away into the dark.

shove._doc: src/shove.py. A landed attack with shove {chance, aim} may throw the hero one tile straight back (a STR save stops it). Never into a wall, water, lava, a pit, a creature or off the map; with aim the shover picks, of the three tiles away from it, one with a hazard the hero would step on.
shove.aimed_line: {The}'s blow throws you back, right where it hurts!
shove.held_line: You keep your feet against {the}'s blow.

casters._doc: src/caster_ai.py (The Caster's Book). A kind's 'spells' (monsters.json) are cast by need: the ready spell whose 'when' holds with the highest 'weight' (ties: the first written). Kinds: ward (Monster.damage_ward 'share' for 'turns'), control (an 'effect' for 'duration' through the rider's road), heal (src/faction.py), escape (a blink four paces off), dispel (one of buff_words' statuses), darkness (light_shy.snuff 'dark'), hurt (pick_attack's weight for one of its own attacks). 'wind_up' spells are chanted a turn first; a blow breaks the chant. 'reach' is how far a spell is aimed; 'cooldown' the default turns before a spell is ready again. Lines: a spell's own 'wind_up' / 'cast' line, else lines.<key>_<kind>, else lines.<key>; {spell} is its name, {buff} the dispelled status.

lines.wind_up_control: {The} begins a low chant, {his} eyes on you.
lines.cast_ward: {The}'s chant ends: a ward of bone and smoke rises about {him}.
lines.cast_dispel: {The} speaks a word of unmaking: your {buff} is torn away!
lines.cast_darkness: {The} closes {his} fist, and the dark comes down.
lines.cast_escape: {The} steps into nothing and is four paces off.
lines.gaze_blind: You cannot meet a gaze you cannot see.
lines.resisted: The curse finds no hold on you.
lines.turned: Your spell turning throws the curse back on {the}!

unseen.wind_up: Somewhere near, a voice begins to chant.
unseen.darkness: Somewhere near, a voice speaks, and your light goes out.
unseen.curse: Somewhere near, a voice speaks a curse.
unseen.dispel: Somewhere near, a voice speaks a word of unmaking: your {buff} is torn away!

holds._doc: src/holds.py (Held Fast). An attack's 'hold' {kind: constrict|swallow|drag, type, break_share, max_turns<=4, save: STR|DEX} that lands takes the hero (a DEX save slips it: the 'held' status). Each holder turn it squeezes for that attack's own dice (no roll to hit), typed; a drag first hauls him a tile toward water within drag_reach and at the water's edge pulls him under (drown_mult). A blow or blows on the holder of break_share of its health between two of its turns frees him; so does a STR or DEX struggle (his step) against the hold's DC plus struggle_dc_add, the holder dying, sleeping, held, afraid or broken, Loosed, the Coif of Beowulf, a family ward against its holds (the Psylli's: data/wards.json riders 'held'), or the status running out. Then he is Recovering (no hold at once again). Lines: <key>_<kind> before <key>; {damage}.

lines.start_swallow: {The} swallows you whole! It is dark, and {his} gut closes round you.
lines.start_drag: {The} seizes you and starts to drag you toward the water!
lines.loosed_loosed: {The}'s grip slides off you: nothing can hold you.
lines.loosed_grendel: Grendel-grip: {the} cannot get a hold on you.
lines.squeeze: {The} holds you fast and crushes you for {damage} damage!
lines.drag: {The} drags you a step toward the water! ({damage} damage)
lines.under: {The} pulls you under the black water! You choke for {damage} damage!
lines.struggle_fail_constrict: You strain against {the}'s coils, but they hold.
lines.struggle_fail: You fight {the}'s grip, but it holds you fast.
lines.free_cut_constrict: {The}'s coils break apart! You are free.
lines.free_cut_swallow: {The}'s gut splits open, and you climb out!
lines.free_dead: {The}'s grip goes slack. You are free.
lines.free_held: {The}'s grip goes slack. You are free.
lines.free_apart: You are out of {the}'s reach, and free.
lines.free_loosed: Nothing can hold you: you slip out of {the}'s grip!
lines.free_warded: Your ward slips you out of {the}'s grip!

auras._doc: src/auras.py (Auras). A kind's 'aura' {kind: fear|stench|heat|cold, radius 1-3, ...} works on the hero each world turn he is within its radius: fear once a fight when he sees it (a WIS save; 'turns'), stench each turn until he once masters his stomach (a CON check; 'effect' for 'turns' at 'chance'), heat and cold a 'share' of his own health a turn (at most twice the strongest at once). A kind's own 'line' / 'steady_line' before these; {damage}.

lines.fear: Dread rolls off {the} like a cold wind, and you turn to run!
lines.fear_steady: Dread rolls off {the}, but you stand your ground. It will not shake you again.
lines.stench: The reek of {the} turns your stomach.
lines.stench_steady: You master your stomach against the reek of {the}.
lines.heat: The heat of {the} scorches you for {damage} damage.
lines.cold: The cold of {the} bites into you for {damage} damage.

unseen.heat: Heat beats at you from somewhere close. ({damage} damage)
unseen.cold: A bitter cold reaches you from somewhere close. ({damage} damage)
unseen.stench: A foul reek from somewhere close turns your stomach.
unseen.stench_steady: You master your stomach against the reek.

home_ground._doc: src/home_ground.py (Home Ground). A 'territorial' kind lets the hero go once he is more than lair_radius + slack tiles from its home and walks back; it knows him again within lair_radius; on its own ground it never breaks. A kind's 'lair_line' before 'line'.
home_ground.line: {The} stops at the edge of {his} ground and watches you go.
home_ground.roused_line: {The} turns on you: {he} will not be struck and walk away.

kit._doc: src/monster_kit.py (Uses What It Carries). A kind's 'kit' [{item, chance}] is rolled once. Under drink_below of its health a healing potion it carries (or stole) is drunk with its turn; a flask of fire oil is thrown at a hero throw_range tiles off with a clear throw. What is left falls where it dies. {potion} {potion_bare} {flask} {amount}.
kit.drink_stolen: {The} gulps down your own {potion_bare}, and {his} wounds close!
kit.drink_wasted: {The} gulps down {potion}, but {his} wound will not close.
kit.drink_unseen: Somewhere near, glass clinks and something drinks.
kit.throw_unseen: Something sails out of the dark at you!

skittish._doc: src/skittish.py (Skittish, Not Suicidal). A cowardly kind keeps keep_near to keep_far tiles off and darts in when the hero's last step took him away from it. Cornered, a kind with a 'bargain' offers its purse once (its treasure roll times gold_mult); the hero is asked (ask_line).
skittish.offer_line: {The}, cornered, offers you gold to let {him} go.
skittish.ask_line: He holds up a fat purse: his gold for his freedom. Take it and let him go?
skittish.void_line: The chance is gone, and the purse with it.

surprise._doc: src/surprise.py (Lurkers Keep Their Promise). An ambusher springs when the hero is within spring_reach tiles with nothing between them; unseen till then, its first blow that lands is a surprise (x1.75, as a mimic's). Spotted first, or a mimic of a kind he knows, it surprises no one.
